rv.q: Chris Wiegand called the production “a blizzard of bruised egos and expertly timed farce”, particularly enjoyable for “long-term Mischief watchers” who will recognise the oft-used running gags and punchlines.

Anna Ryan thought “while the slapstick and mayhem that ensues is hardly new ground for the company, the endless stream of slip-ups is what we’re here for.” She wrote, “It’s a script that leaves no loose end – every single line has a worthwhile, deliciously funny purpose.
